title: Structure-informed model selects antibody variants active against SARS-CoV-2 escape variants
summary: ESM-IF1 scored substitutions in antibody–antigen complexes, and researchers experimentally screened variants of two clinical antibodies. The journal article reports up to 25-fold neutralization improvement against BQ.1.1 and up to 37-fold affinity improvement against XBB.1.5; these are distinct assays/variants. The preprint abstract reports a different neutralization figure, so this record uses journal values and does not backdate them to preprint v1.

evidence.tested: PMC-hosted primary article reports experimental screening and improved neutralization/affinity results for antibody variants.
evidence.unknown: Exact v1 result content and sequence-level overlap with earlier group studies not completely established; no clinical efficacy.
evidence.ai_role: Structure-informed inverse-folding scores guided substitutions followed by antibody binding and neutralization tests.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
